items.raw_excerpt: Only 2 km from Praia da Rocha, Praia do Vau offers a quieter alternative while still having everything you need for a day at the beach.
items.summary_en: Praia do Vau is a quiet beach just 2 km from Praia da Rocha in Portugal's Algarve. It offers everything you need for a relaxing day by the sea.

items.raw_excerpt: It's said you can buy a 3 bedroom house in Balclutha for $350,000.
items.summary_en: Balclutha is a small town in the Otago region of New Zealand. A 3-bedroom house can be bought for about $350,000. The town has hundreds of jobs waiting for workers.

items.title_en: Balclutha offers affordable housing and hundreds of jobs

items.summary_en: Vietnam provides gifts and support to people affected by Agent Orange. The program helps victims of the chemical used during the war. This aid aims to improve living conditions for affected families.

items.raw_excerpt: Moradores precisavam percorrer longas distâncias navegando pelo rio para conseguir uma consulta médica
items.summary_en: Residents of remote riverside communities in Amazonas state used to travel long distances by river to receive medical care. A new project now brings healthcare directly to these communities. This initiative helps improve access to medical services for isolated populations.
items.summary_ko: 아마조나스 주의 외딴 강변 마을들은 의료 서비스를 받기 위해 강을 따라 먼 거리를 이동해야 했습니다. 새로운 프로젝트는 이러한 마을들에게 직접 의료 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 사업은 고립된 인구의 의료 접근성을 개선하는 데 도움이 됩니다.
items.title_en: Project brings medical care to riverside communities in Amazonas
